title: Targefect-BAC mediated Efficient Transfection of Bacterial Artificial Chromosomes into mammalian cells
protocol: Set up cells so they are approximately 60-70% confluent the day of the experiment.
To 1 ml of serum-free DMEM, add 1 μg DNA.
Add 5 μl of Targefect-BAC (Targefect F-2) to the mixture.
Add 15 μl of the peptide enhancer to the mixture.
Mix well after each addition.
Incubate at 37°C for 20 minutes to form complexes.
Aspirate off all culture media from the cells to be transfected.
Wash cells once with serum-free DMEM.
Add 1 ml of transfection complex per well for a 6-well dish.
Add 0.4 ml of transfection complex per well for a 12-well dish.
Add 0.2 ml of transfection complex per well for a 24-well dish.
Swirl the dish to ensure transfection complexes cover cells well.
Incubate at 37°C for 2 hours.
Aspirate off the transfection complex after 2 hours.
Replace with appropriate volume of complete media (2 ml for a 6-well dish, 1 ml for a 12-well dish, or 0.5 ml for a 24-well dish).
Assay at 24 hours post-transfection.
If cells need to go longer, replace the media the next day.
Prepare transfection complexes by adding 10 μg of BAC DNA to 0.5 ml high glucose DMEM.
Mix well by flicking the tube.
Add 25 μl of Targefect-BAC and mix well again.
To 0.5 ml of high glucose DMEM add 6 μg of BAC DNA.
Mix well by flicking the tube.
Add 12.5 μl of Targefect-BAC and mix well again.
Add 25 μl of Virofect and mix well again.
Incubate the tubes at 37°C for 25 minutes to form the transfection complexes.
Add 0.25 ml of the transfection mix to 2 ml of complete media for a single well in a 6-well dish (or for a 35 mm dish).
Prepare 0.5 ml of transfection complex per 60 mm dish and 1 ml of transfection complex per 100mm dish.
Swirl the dish to mix transfection complexes with the cell culture media (with 5-10% serum).
Incubate overnight at 37°C in CO2 incubator.
Replace the media with fresh complete media the next morning.
Assay cells at 36-48 hrs post-transfection.
